A.L.Browna)
(Received:9December2009;Revised:27March2010;Accepted:28March2010)
Despite the current expansion of interest in soundscapes, the roles and
application of the concept, vis-à-vis that of environmental noise management,
have not been adequately articulated. Soundscapes and environmental noise
managementarecomplementary,notcompeting,approacheswithrespecttothe
study and management of the outdoor acoustic environment. Their
